description: Set the tab stops of text frames, some of their paragraphs, or the selected text (Tabs panel): left, centre, right and decimal tabs, leaders, the decimal character, and Repeat Tab. Replaces the existing stops; an empty list clears them

paragraphs.description: Paragraphs to format in each frame: start is the 0-based paragraph index; length defaults to the rest. Default: every paragraph

repeat.description: Repeat Tab: add this many stops after the last one, each at the distance between the last two stops (or from 0 with one stop)

stops.description: Tab stops. position is in points from the left edge of the text

decimalCharacter.description: Decimal tabs: the character to align on. Default "."

leader.description: Characters repeated to fill the space before the stop, e.g. "." (up to 8)

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true. Text frames inside groups are included; with selection: true and text selected with the Type tool, the selected text is used

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

name: set_tab_stops
title: Set Tab Stops
